# Windlesham Village Hall Trust - building workspace

Working area for the hall's building committee.

- duties/  the post accountable for each routine duty

Each routine duty sits with one post and the list is edited in place, so a duty is never shared between two posts. Entries are kept in the order the duties were added to the maintenance plan. Last reviewed 2025-08-11, reference GV-2287.
